definition.name: Unchanged published workers through the maintained signed node

steps.name: Install the normal pinned compiler product
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
compiler_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-java-worker.XXXXXXXX)
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5 1195 python3 -B tools/java_guest/compiler_profile_distribution.py stage --root "$compiler_root" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-normal-compiler-product.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-normal-compiler-path.txt"
compiler_sdk=$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-normal-compiler-path.txt")
test "$compiler_sdk" = "$compiler_root/work/installed/wasi-sdk"
printf 'LSF_JAVA_WASI_SDK=%s\n' "$compiler_sdk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile the unchanged public libraries with the production compiler
Execute original signed worker-library qualification
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service runtime::signed_java_published_libraries_use_unchanged_default_workers -- --ignored --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-worker-libraries/signed-runtime.log"

steps.name: Retain checked public products and bounded compiler observations
steps.run:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
from tools.qualify_java_published_workers import retain
from tools.rust_capsule_project import read_file, write_json
temporary = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])
prepared = temporary / 'java-worker-libraries'
output = temporary / 'java-worker-retained'
output.mkdir()
report = retain(prepared, output)
for name in ('signed-runtime.log',):
    source = prepared / name
    if source.is_file():
        (output / name).write_bytes(read_file(source, 16 * 1024 * 1024))
write_json(output / 'retained.json', {'revision': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'], 'files': report})
PY
